06:20 / About
M. Kashan KhanSindh, PK

I started editing video for social before AI tooling was any good, then moved into AI content full time when it became clear that a single product photo could carry a whole campaign.

Today I work with clothing and product brands who need new pictures far more often than they can afford new shoots. A colourway drops, a season changes, a market opens, and the answer used to be another shoot day. Now it isn't.

Based in Pakistan, working with clients worldwide. Currently studying Computer Science at the University of Sindh alongside client work.
